report.source_text: She then underwent surgery with cytoreduction of the tumor (resection of round and falciform ligament, and resection of omental cake/partial resection of the greater omentum) and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC). Due to the overall extension of the disease, the patient was then referred to palliative chemotherapy at her local hospital, which she continues to receive to this day, with a partial response to treatment.

clinician.final_diagnosis: Malignant peritoneal mesothelioma (MPM) of the epidermoid type
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 73-year-old woman presented with constitutional syndrome, abdominal pain, and diarrhea. Prior pancreatic cyst history existed. Abdominal CT revealed peritoneal effusion with peritoneal carcinomatosis and adnexa edema. Biopsy of abdominal lesions confirmed MPM of the epidermoid type. She underwent surgical cytoreduction and HIPEC. Due to disease extent, palliative chemotherapy was initiated, resulting in partial response.
